messages:
maria: Heads-up: triaging a set of Go vuln reports that touch grpc, golang-jwt, and net/http. Need owners and a hotpatch plan. CVEs referenced in thread below.
ajay: Which CVEs exactly? PoC or exploitability notes?
maria: Links: NVD refs - CVE-2026-1111 (grpc), CVE-2026-1112 (golang-jwt parsing), CVE-2026-1113 (net/http header handling). No public exploit seen yet but high impact for services that parse external JWTs or expose grpc endpoints.
evan: Affected services I can think of: inference-runtime (grpc client/server), auth-proxy (jwt parsing), public-api-gateway (net/http edge). Auth-proxy uses github.com/golang-jwt/jwt v3.x; inference-runtime pins google.golang.org/grpc v1.54.
priya: Short-term mitigations? WAF, stricter header validation, disable HTTP/2 on the gateway?
maria: Short-term plan: 1) Patch & pin modules in go.mod and open hotfix PRs. 2) Run unit + e2e smoke. 3) Canary rollout (small %). 4) Enable extra audit logging for JWT parse failures. 5) If upgrade breaks, apply runtime mitigation (disable http2 or stricter header checks).
ajay: I'll take grpc. Local repro steps: run `go test ./...` then `go get google.golang.org/grpc@v1.56.0` and `go mod tidy`. I'm opening PR `hotfix/grpc-cve-1799991111`. Example commands:
```
# update grpc
go get google.golang.org/grpc@v1.56.0
# tidy modules
go mod tidy
# run unit tests
make test
```
maria: Add a changelog line and note the runtime flag for fallback. @sec-bot please open an incident with severity Elevated and list owners.
sec-bot: Incident created: SEC-2026-045. Severity: Elevated. https://internal/SEC-2026-045
evan: I'll own golang-jwt migration to v4. Quick plan: try `github.com/golang-jwt/jwt/v4`, run compatibility tests, add a small adaptor for old token formats if needed. If major API changes, we'll vendor a shim.
priya: Testing checklist (short): unit tests, auth-proxy -> public-api integration, smoke for cache/key rotation, p99 latency, error rates. Canary window min 24h, prefer 48h for jwt edge cases.
ajay: Deploy plan: build hotpatch image tags, push as canary. Route 2% traffic for 6h, 10% for 18h, then 100% if stable. Rollback plan: revert to previous image tag; trigger if 5xx > 0.5% or p99 latency > 30% increase.
maria: :thumbsup: Timeline: PRs today, CI + integration tests tonight, canary tomorrow morning. Owners: ajay(grpc), evan(jwt), priya(canary/monitoring).
deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled for SEC-2026-045 at 2026-03-21T08:00:00Z.
evan: One more note — for net/http CVE, if upgrade requires Go runtime bump (stdlib fix), we should coordinate OS image rebuilds. Might need to bump base image to `golang:1.20.8` (or later patched). I'll validate binary size and startup.
priya: I'll add dashboard widgets: 5xx rate, jwt-parse-error count, p99 latency for the next 72h. If we see any regression, we'll abort and roll back.
maria: Thanks team — please drop PR links here and mark SEC ticket. I'll prepare customer-facing comms if we decide to public post.
